{"metadata":{"description":"Official KolmoPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness with durable API-key and settings integration.","id":"gh:1336998995","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-kolmopdf","slug":"komoai2026/dsh-kolmopdf","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","document-processing","dsh","dsh-plugin","harness","kolmopdf","pdf","pdf-document","pdf-to-markdown","pdf-tools","pdf-translation"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Official KolmoPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness with durable API-key and settings integration."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# kolmopdf"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"KolmoPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness: high-fidelity PDF→Markdown parsing, layout-preserving PDF trans"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"lation, Markdown conversion, credit estimates, and balance checks."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Repository: <https://github.com/komoai2026/dsh-kolmopdf>"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Tool | Capability |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `kolmopdf_parse_pdf` | PDF → Markdown, optional translation, formulas, tables, images, enrichment "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"sidecars |
| `kolmopdf_translate_pdf` | Layout-preserving PDF translation (translated-only or side-b"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"y-side) |
| `kolmopdf_convert_markdown` | Markdown/ZIP → DOCX, HTML, PDF, LaTeX |
| `kolmopdf_estima"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"te_cost` | Local page-count + balance estimate (does not spend credits) |
| `kolmopdf_check_balance`"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" | Current credit balance |
| `kolmopdf_get_task_status` | Inspect a task by id |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- The GUI stores the API key through DSH credentials (`KOLMOPDF_API_KEY`). The value never rides set"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"tings describe responses.
- **Settings → KolmoPDF** is a dedicated settings page (configured / missi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ng, save, clear) with a **live credits** card and a **task overview** list — balance and task status"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"es refresh automatically (30 s / 10 s) and manually, with a clear-log action. Task history lives in "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"`$DSH_HOME/kolmopdf/tasks.json` (newest 200).
- Tools check the key lazily. A missing key tells the "},{"id":"p9s6","text":"user to open Settings or run the CLI.
- `KOLMOPDF_API_KEY` in the process environment is also accept"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ed. An env key shadows the GUI credential and makes the settings page read-only.
- HTTP upload, poll"},{"id":"p9s8","text":", download, and ZIP extract honor the tool abort signal."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Node.js >= 20
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2` compatible (0.1.1-rc.2 client-modules format: `dsh.c"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"lient` manifest + `exports["./client"]` lazy-CJS bundle)
- KolmoPDF Plus or Pro account
- An API key"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" from <https://www.kolmopdf.com/api-keys>"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Install the package into the DSH profile you use (example: `web`). GitHub is the recommended path:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This is a git dependency that ships prebuilt `lib/` (no `prepare` script, so `dsh plugin add` does n"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ot hit pnpm `allowBuilds`). The package also declares `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin add` appends `@ko"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"lmopdf/dsh-kolmopdf` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` and the plugin mounts on the next start "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"— settings page and tools appear without a hand-written composition row."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Host packages such as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` are **optional peer** dependencies (same pattern as d"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"sh-ads): they must resolve to the running Harness copy, and pnpm treats them as optional so a profil"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"e install does not warn about them. Shipping a second copy inside this plugin makes every tool call "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"fail with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Other install sources:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` already activates the bundle layer. Only add a host-plane row yourself if you insta"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lled the package some other way:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Publishing"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"One `Release & Publish` workflow (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) handles the pipeline end to end:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Change `version` in `package.json` and push to `main`** — the workflow compares it with the late"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"st `v*` tag, creates `v<version>` on the bump commit and pushes it, then publishes in the same run. "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"The tag push uses the internal token, which does not re-trigger the push event, so the same run cont"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"inues straight into publishing. A push that does not change the version is a green no-op.
- Manually"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" pushing a matching tag works too: `git tag v1.0.0 && git push origin v1.0.0` releases exactly that "},{"id":"p23s6","text":"tag. The tag must equal `package.json` version exactly, or the job fails.
- Prerelease versions (`-`"},{"id":"p23s7","text":" in the version) publish under the `next` dist-tag, stable versions under `latest`.
- Publishing use"},{"id":"p23s8","text":"s **pnpm** (`pnpm publish`) with **npm trusted publishing** (OpenID Connect): the workflow holds `id"},{"id":"p23s9","text":"-token: write`, npm exchanges the GitHub Actions ID token for a short-lived token bound to this work"},{"id":"p23s10","text":"flow file, and provenance attestations are generated automatically (`--provenance`). **No `NPM_TOKEN"},{"id":"p23s11","text":"` secret is used.**
- `pnpm publish` runs `pnpm check` first (each publish packs a freshly built `li"},{"id":"p23s12","text":"b/`), then a GitHub Release is created with generated notes.
- The `Rebuild lib` workflow keeps the "},{"id":"p23s13","text":"committed `lib/` in sync with `src/` on every push to `main` (git installs never run prepare scripts"},{"id":"p23s14","text":").
- `CI` workflow typechecks, tests, and builds on every PR and push to main."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"One-time setup: on npmjs.com open `@kolmopdf/dsh-kolmopdf` → Settings → Trusted publishing and autho"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"rize GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/release.yml`) for this repository (public repo; publishing r"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"equires `@kolmopdf` scope access). The `npm trust` CLI can create the publisher too. With trusted pu"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"blishing in place you can revoke the package's automation token — the workflow never sends one."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"See `examples/cordis.patch.yml` and the package-root `cordis.patch.yml`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Restart the profile:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configure the API key"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Option 1: Web Settings (recommended)"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"In the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"1. Open **Settings**.
2. Open the **KolmoPDF** section.
3. Enter the API key and save."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The page writes the key into the DSH credential store (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, reference `KOL"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"MOPDF_API_KEY`). It does not go through the settings-document allowlist. If `KOLMOPDF_API_KEY` is al"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"ready in the process environment, the page is read-only (env wins and cannot be overwritten)."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"A missing key does not prevent the plugin from starting. The first authenticated tool call returns a"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"n actionable prompt."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- Do not put a real API key in the repo, README, screenshots, or issues.
- The Web credentials API r"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"eports only configured / writable state, never the secret.
- The CLI `status` command only prints co"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"nfigured / not configured.
- Tools read local PDF/Markdown/ZIP paths from the model and write under "},{"id":"p36s4","text":"`outputDir`. Enable this plugin only in a trusted composition.
- Output directories are checked with"},{"id":"p36s5","text":" `realpath` so `output_subdir` and symlinks cannot escape `outputDir`.
- ZIP extraction rejects abso"},{"id":"p36s6","text":"lute paths and `../` entries. Caps: 10,000 entries, 4 GiB uncompressed, 2 GiB download.
- Inputs are"},{"id":"p36s7","text":" capped at 300 MB and 800 pages (same as the KolmoPDF service) and validated locally before upload."}],"truncated":true}
